visual.title: The discriminant at a critical point
visual.caption: At the origin the surface rises in one direction and falls in the other. The gradient vanishes, so only the second derivatives can tell which kind of critical point it is.

predict.question: For f = x² − y² at the origin, D = f_xx f_yy − f_xy² is:
predict.explain: f_xx = 2, f_yy = −2 and f_xy = 0, so D = −4. A negative discriminant means a saddle.
